response.what_it_is: Car engine with automatic transmission assembly (alleged Toyota/Lexus 2GR engine)
hidden_risks: Internal engine wear and tear (cylinder scoring, piston ring condition)
Transmission slip or internal gear damage
Functional state of attached sensors, alternator, and wiring
History of overheating or prior rebuilds
seller_claims_unsupported: Exact engine code (2GR) and compatibility confirmed only by visual inspection rather than documentation
response.failure_mode: Mistaking a generic used engine assembly for a fully refurbished or guaranteed unit, or misidentifying the exact engine displacement/code from external appearance alone.
